presentation.description:
Display a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte for the map link from the in-game chat.

ゲーム内チャットのマップリンクに、最寄りのエーテライトへのテレポリンクを表示します。

Zeigt zu jedem Kartenlink im Spielchat einen Teleport-Link zum nächstgelegenen Ätheryten an.

Affiche un lien de téléportation vers l'éthérite la plus proche pour les liens de carte du chat en jeu.

variant.author: OOF Games
variant.changelog:
Introducing Aetheric Flow!

Adds a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte on every map link in chat.

Key Features:
- Adds a clickable teleport link after map coordinates in chat.
- Picks the nearest aetheryte you have attuned in that zone.
- /aftp teleports to the most recent map link for controller players.
- Choose which chat channels are scanned.
- English, Japanese, German and French are all supported.

variant.author: OOF Games
variant.changelog:
**Scrollable Tabs** is a lightweight plugin that lets you use the mouse wheel to switch tabs.

The following windows are supported and can be toggled individually:

- Aether Currents
- Armoury Chest
- Blue Magic Spellbook
- Character
- Character -> Classes/Jobs
- Character -> Reputation
- Chocobo Saddlebag
- Companion
- Currency
- Facewear
- Fashion Accessories
- Field Records
- Fish Guide
- Glamour Dresser (scrolls pages, not tabs)
- Gold Saucer -> Card List
- Gold Saucer -> Decks -> Edit Deck
- Gold Saucer -> Lord of Verminion -> Minion Hotbar
- Inventory
- Island Minion Guide
- Minions
- Mounts
- Retainer Inventory
- Shared FATE
- Sightseeing Log

The Command Panel already includes this functionality and instead has an option to disable its tab-scrolling sound effect.

Plugin configuration is available via Plugin Installer.
